headword: {移植手術|いしょくしゅじゅつ}

definitions.gloss: transplant surgery; transplant operation; organ transplant
definitions.explanation: A surgical procedure in which an organ or tissue is transferred from one body (or location in the same body) to another. Most commonly refers to organ transplants such as heart, kidney, or liver transplants.

examples.japanese: {移植手術|いしょくしゅじゅつ}は{無事|ぶじ}に{終|お}わった。
{心臓|しんぞう}の{移植手術|いしょくしゅじゅつ}を{受|う}けるために{渡米|とべい}した。
examples.english: He went to America to undergo a heart transplant operation.

examples.japanese: {臓器|ぞうき}の{提供者|ていきょうしゃ}が{見|み}つかり、ようやく{移植手術|いしょくしゅじゅつ}を{行|おこな}うことができた。
examples.english: An organ donor was found, and the transplant surgery could finally be performed.

notes:
A compound of {移植|いしょく} (transplant, grafting) and {手術|しゅじゅつ} (surgery, operation). {移植|いしょく} alone can refer to the broader concept of transplantation (including plant grafting), while {移植手術|いしょくしゅじゅつ} specifically refers to surgical transplant procedures.

Organ transplant is a frequent topic in Japanese news, particularly regarding the {臓器移植法|ぞうきいしょくほう} (Organ Transplant Law) and debates about brain death criteria.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {移植手術|いしょくしゅじゅつ}を{受|う}ける: to undergo transplant surgery
- {移植手術|いしょくしゅじゅつ}を{行|おこな}う: to perform transplant surgery
- {移植手術|いしょくしゅじゅつ}に{成功|せいこう}する: to succeed in transplant surgery
- {腎臓|じんぞう}の{移植手術|いしょくしゅじゅつ}: kidney transplant surgery

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {臓器移植|ぞうきいしょく}: organ transplant — focuses on the organs being transplanted
- {手術|しゅじゅつ}: surgery — the general term for any surgical procedure
- {移植|いしょく}: transplant/grafting — the broader concept including non-surgical contexts
